method: GitHub issue search for user-reported Step Functions defects quoting the runtime error StepCheck's sound tier predicts (e.g. the JSONPath-not-found error SC1101 statically prevents). Unlike fix-commit pairs, the defect is reported by a real user, not inferred from a diff. Because these repositories build the state machine in CDK/code (no clean *.asl.json), StepCheck is confirmed on a minimal reproduction of the reported structure; the issue URL and verbatim runtime error are given for independent verification.
extraction_note: Production Step Functions machines are overwhelmingly CDK/SAM-generated (verified via authenticated code search over 26 candidate repos), so a standalone pre-fix *.asl.json is rarely committed. But CDK ultimately synthesizes ASL: for campus-compute #32 we cloned the repo, checked out the buggy commit, ran `cdk synth` (neutralizing one Docker-bundled Lambda *layer*, which does not affect the state machine), and extracted the REAL synthesized DefinitionString -- StepCheck then flags the exact user-reported defect. For issues whose repos we did not synth, StepCheck is confirmed on a minimal reproduction of the reported structure with the issue URL and verbatim error for verification.
cdk_synth_method: git checkout <buggy-commit>; cdk synth; then `stepcheck check cdk.out/Stack.template.json` -- the CloudFormation front end (stepcheck/src/cfn.rs) now reads the synthesized template directly (finds every AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine, resolves Fn::Sub/Join/Ref keeping AWS pseudo-parameters exact). It also reads SAM/CloudFormation template.yaml directly (`stepcheck check template.yaml`). The standalone eval/cdk_extract_asl.py is kept only as a reference; the tool no longer needs it.

defects.title: SFN AuditLogFailed state fails: $.execution_id not found in SNS publish response
defects.reported_runtime_error: The JSONPath '$.execution_id' specified for the field 'execution_id.$' could not be found in the input '{"MessageId": ...}'
defects.defect: AuditLogFailed reads $.execution_id, but the preceding NotifyFailure (SNS Publish) has the default ResultPath=$, replacing the whole document with the SNS envelope {MessageId, SequenceNumber}; execution_id is gone.
defects.extraction: REAL: cloned the repo, checked out the buggy commit 3977ec8 (v0.8.0, which introduced the audit log), ran `cdk synth`, and extracted the actual synthesized state machine DefinitionString (14 states) with CloudFormation intrinsics resolved. Not a hand reproduction.
defects.stepcheck: SC1101 on AuditLogFailed (and AuditLogSucceeded) reads '$.execution_id' etc., with --result-shapes; confirmed on the cdk-synthesized ASL

defects.title: ASL generator does not pass items_s3_uri to chunking lambda for first-step fan-outs
defects.reported_runtime_error: the Step Functions execution fails immediately because the ASL looks for $.input which doesn't exist in the trigger payload
defects.defect: The first fan-out step reads $.input, but the trigger payload provides items_s3_uri (no 'input' field).

defects.title: An error occurred while executing the state 'Emit - Awaiting Completion TT'
defects.reported_runtime_error: The JSONPath '$.detail.orderId' specified for the field 'orderId.$' could not be found in the input '{"orderNumber":"10"}'
defects.defect: The 'Emit - Awaiting Completion TT' state reads $.detail.orderId, but the workflow input is {orderNumber} (no detail.orderId). Reported by a workshop user who reran the lab three times.
defects.stepcheck: SC1101 on 'Emit - Awaiting Completion TT' reads '$.detail.orderId'; also SC6001 (waitForTaskToken callback with no timeout)

second_pass_standalone_asl.finding: the 'Embed' task (SQS sendMessage, non-idempotent) is retried on States.TaskFailed with MaxAttempts=3, so a transient failure may deliver the message up to three times.
second_pass_standalone_asl.note: advisory (inferred non-idempotent) tier; a real standalone .asl.json from an independent repo, tied to the FR that built the pipeline.

second_pass_standalone_asl.finding: CLEAN: this subscription saga has proper compensation on its persistent steps; StepCheck reports no finding. Recorded as an honest negative -- not every saga is broken.

note: Existence evidence complementing the 7 curated fix-commit pairs: real user-filed issues whose reported runtime error is exactly what StepCheck's sound data-flow tier prevents at build time (one from an official AWS workshop). SC1101 is the most issue-tracker-visible class because it crashes with a clear JSONPath error; concurrency/compensation defects are rarely filed as workflow-definition bugs. Related classes seen but not counted (state machine not reproducible or class outside the sound tier): aws-samples/iam-identity-center-team#513 (missing retry on SsoAdmin.Conflict), susumutomita/TenkaCloud#758 (missing event.detail field).
